basics.name: Hadi Shokati
basics.label: Soil Scientist
basics.summary: Soil scientist at the University of Tübingen.

work.name: Faculty of Soil Science & Geomorphology, University of Tübingen
work.summary: Soil Erosion modeling using Deep Learning and Remote Sensing in Precision Agriculture.

publications.name: A GLUE-based assessment of WaTEM/SEDEM for simulating soil erosion, transport, and deposition in soil conservation optimised agricultural watersheds
publications.summary: This study assesses the performance of WaTEM/SEDEM using a GLUE-based uncertainty framework for simulating soil erosion, transport, and deposition in optimized agricultural watersheds.

publications.name: Rapid Flood Mapping from Aerial Imagery Using Fine-Tuned SAM and ResNet-Backboned U-Net
publications.summary: This work presents a fine-tuned SAM and ResNet-based U-Net approach for rapid and accurate flood mapping using aerial imagery.

publications.name: Comparing UAV-Based Hyperspectral and Satellite-Based Multispectral Data for Soil Moisture Estimation Using Machine Learning
publications.summary: This paper compares UAV hyperspectral and satellite multispectral data for soil moisture estimation using various machine learning algorithms.

publications.name: Erosion-SAM: Semantic segmentation of soil erosion by water
publications.summary: A deep learning framework, Erosion-SAM, is developed for semantic segmentation of soil erosion features from remote sensing imagery.

publications.name: BIPE: A Bi-Layer Predictive Ensemble Framework for Forest Fire Susceptibility Mapping in Germany
publications.summary: This study introduces BIPE, a bi-layer predictive ensemble framework for mapping forest fire susceptibility across Germany.

publications.name: Assessment of Land Suitability Potential Using Ensemble Approaches of Advanced Multi-Criteria Decision Models and Machine Learning for Wheat Cultivation
publications.summary: An ensemble approach combining advanced decision models and machine learning to assess land suitability for wheat cultivation.

publications.name: Assessing the Role of Environmental Covariates and Pixel Size in Soil Property Prediction: A Comparative Study of Various Areas in Southwest Iran
publications.summary: This paper investigates the effects of pixel size and environmental covariates on soil property prediction performance.

publications.name: Random Forest-Based Soil Moisture Estimation Using Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and UAV-Based Hyperspectral Data
publications.summary: A random forest model is developed to estimate soil moisture using data from Sentinel-2, Landsat-8/9, and UAV hyperspectral imagery.

publications.name: Assessing reliability of rainwater harvesting systems for meeting water demands in different climatic zones of Iran
publications.summary: This paper evaluates the reliability of rainwater harvesting systems across different Iranian climatic zones.

publications.name: Evaluating the Accuracy of Precipitation Products Over Utah, United States, Using the Google Earth Engine Platform
publications.summary: The study evaluates various satellite precipitation products over Utah using Google Earth Engine analysis.

publications.name: Assessing soil moisture levels using visible UAV imagery and machine learning models
publications.publisher: Remote Sensing Applications: Society and Environment
publications.summary: This paper explores the potential of visible UAV imagery combined with ML models for soil moisture estimation.

publications.name: Designing of Rainwater Harvesting Systems Using Drone Images
publications.summary: This study uses drone images to design and optimize rainwater harvesting systems. (In Persian)

publications.name: Reliability, Optimization and Economic Analysis of the Rainwater Harvesting System from the Rooftop
publications.publisher: Iranian Journal of Irrigation and Water Engineering
publications.summary: A study on the reliability, optimization, and cost-effectiveness of rooftop rainwater harvesting systems. (In Persian)

publications.name: Urban runoff management in sustainable development and the environment
publications.summary: This Persian-language paper discusses urban runoff management strategies for sustainable development.

publications.name: Estimation of Evapotranspiration in Landscape by WUCOLS, PF and IPOS Methods
publications.summary: A comparative estimation of landscape evapotranspiration using WUCOLS, PF, and IPOS methods. (In Persian)

publications.name: Optimization and Feasibility Study of using Rainwater Harvesting Systems in Ardabil
publications.summary: This Persian-language study evaluates the feasibility and optimization of rainwater harvesting systems in Ardabil.

projects.name: Quantum Computing
projects.summary: Quantum computing is the use of quantum-mechanical phenomena such as superposition and entanglement to perform computation. Computers that perform quantum computations are known as quantum computers.
